description: Repair or regenerate a local image region using a mask and prompt.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the base image. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

maskUrl.description: Public URL of the mask image.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

prompt.description: Prompt describing how to redraw the masked area.
